subject: GMRFLib_opt_estimate_hessian: ensure spd for Hessian: mode seems fine

messages.author: 3bcfe982398880d3
messages.subject: GMRFLib_opt_estimate_hessian: ensure spd for Hessian: mode seems fine
parts:
I am running a model across multiple datasets. In 99% of the datasets, the model runs fine. But on one dataset this error comes up:

GMRFLib_opt_estimate_hessian: ensure spd for Hessian: mode seems fine GMRFLib_opt_estimate_hessian: set tol=[4.326e-06]. number of negative eigenvalues=[2]

Can anyone help interpret this? Offer advice?

The model looks broadly like this:

inla(y ~
              x +
              f(x2, model = "ar1", replicate = group) +
              a bunch of random effects...
              family = "gaussian", etc...)

I have also tried setting the int.strategy = "eb" in the experimental version, and it then runs succesfuly, but my coeficients on x don't look right (relative to expecation and a simulation)

Tom

parts:
Better initial values, or more importantly, more sensible priors, will
help as there are several different explainations of your data with the
give model.

parts:
this seems like a out of memory issue.

with R-4.3, then the most recent testing version will be better with
memory, so you can try that one. you can also set

control.compute=list(save.memory=TRUE)

to be even more agressive.

let me know how that works out
